{
    "sla_rules": [
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_001",
            "metric": "DaysToHire",
            "threshold": 45.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 200,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 5,
            "description": "5% penalty if DaysToHire exceeds 45 days",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_002",
            "metric": "InterviewCompletionRatePercent",
            "threshold": 95.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 150,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 3,
            "description": "3% penalty if Interview Completion Rate falls below 95%",
            "applicable_period": "monthly"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_003",
            "metric": "OfferAcceptanceRatePercent",
            "threshold": 90.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 100,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 2,
            "description": "2% penalty if Offer Acceptance Rate falls below 90%",
            "applicable_period": "monthly"
        }
    ],
    "violation_conditions": [
        {
            "metric": "DaysToHire",
            "condition": "DaysToHire > 45",
            "penalty_rule": "5% penalty per incident for exceeding 45 days to hire"
        },
        {
            "metric": "InterviewCompletionRatePercent",
            "condition": "InterviewCompletionRatePercent < 95",
            "penalty_rule": "3% monthly penalty for Interview Completion Rate under 95%"
        },
        {
            "metric": "OfferAcceptanceRatePercent",
            "condition": "OfferAcceptanceRatePercent < 90",
            "penalty_rule": "2% monthly penalty for Offer Acceptance Rate under 90%"
        }
    ],
    "sql_query": "SELECT IncidentID, CASE WHEN DaysToHire > 45 THEN (monthly_service_fee * 0.05) WHEN InterviewCompletionRatePercent < 95 THEN (monthly_service_fee * 0.03) WHEN OfferAcceptanceRatePercent < 90 THEN (monthly_service_fee * 0.02) ELSE 0 END as penalty_amount FROM incidents_teacher_hiring",
    "data_fields_required": ["IncidentID", "DaysToHire", "InterviewCompletionRatePercent", "OfferAcceptanceRatePercent"],
    "monthly_service_fee": 10000,
    "max_monthly_penalty_percentage": 10
}
